answer: Each identity must finish one voyage through the yarrow relay chain to mint a relic: a token released after a latency-hard beacon arrives, beacons departing in slot order. Voyage one costs one minute, fake N waits N slots, so N fakes cost N(N+1)/2 minutes: ten cost 55, a hundred 8,417. The chain is one track, so slots cannot be parallelized and the wait grows quadratically.
